summary: Chemomab Therapeutics Ltd. furnished on Form 6-K the results of its annual general shareholders meeting held on April 28, 2026 and adjourned to May 5, 2026. Shareholders approved the re-election of directors Neil Cohen and Claude Nicaise, the compensation policy, an increase in authorized share capital with corresponding articles amendment, and the re-appointment of KPMG as independent auditor. All proposals passed by the requisite majority under Israeli law. This is a routine meeting outcome report, equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07 filing. No special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign, is disclosed.
